main.description: Checks a release of a package as every fetch will, and holds it, outside the package's repository, until the package's maintainers attest it and 'dev.zena-lang.host.completeRelease' writes it, at the record key equal to its version. Holding it reserves the version, for seven days. The caller must be a maintainer of the package, and every blob the release references must have been uploaded with 'dev.zena-lang.host.uploadArtifact'. Publishing a held release again, with the same record, answers the same.

uri.description: Where the release record will be written, which an attestation names.

cid.description: The release record's CID, which an attestation names.

errors.name: VersionExists
errors.description: The package has a release of that version, or holds another release of it waiting for approval. Releases are never replaced.

errors.name: BlobNotFound
errors.description: The release references a blob that was not uploaded to the package.

errors.name: InvalidRelease
errors.description: The release does not follow 'dev.zena-lang.package.release', an artifact kind is one the host does not store, or the release fails the checks of 'Validating releases': its source archive is not the artifact it names or disagrees with it, its manifest names another package than the profile, a dependency is not published or is retracted, or the manifest has no description or no SPDX license.
